hypothesis: Shaw conductance contributes to l-LNv membrane potential rhythm.
biological_unit_definition: one brain per fly; one primary cell per brain
sample_size_basis: feasibility variance estimate; not confirmatory power
primary_readout: whole-cell resting membrane potential and peak K current
analysis_plan: predefined QC then biological-unit summary by ZT; exploratory effect size and CI
expected_result_matrix: blocker effect at one phase only vs phase-dependent effect vs no effect
alternative_explanations: off-target peptide; cell-selection bias; bath application kinetics
go_no_go_rule: advance only if direction replicates and QC passes in independent preparation

hypothesis: Shal functional current varies across circadian time.
causal_link: functional current rhythm -> membrane potential rhythm
biological_unit_definition: one cell nested in one brain nested in one fly
analysis_plan: cluster-aware exploratory analysis by biological replicate and CT
expected_result_matrix: current rhythm vs no rhythm vs preparation drift
alternative_explanations: recording drift; cell-type misidentification; circadian time misalignment
go_no_go_rule: advance to perturbation only if rhythm survives QC and independent day

hypothesis: External input changes channel-dependent membrane rhythm.
biological_unit_definition: one brain per fly; matched cells across light and sham conditions
primary_readout: whole-cell membrane potential and blocker-sensitive current
controls: light_control; retinal_control; driver_only; effector_only; background; time_matched
analysis_plan: predefined light/sham contrasts stratified by circadian time
expected_result_matrix: acute input effect vs channel-independent depolarization vs phototoxicity
alternative_explanations: opsin expression variability; retinal depletion; synaptic polysynaptic effects
go_no_go_rule: advance only if sham and retinal controls are clean and effect is blocker-sensitive

hypothesis: Shaw current rhythm mediates l-LNv membrane potential rhythm.
causal_link: molecular or functional channel rhythm -> membrane potential rhythm
biological_unit_definition: one fly contributes one primary l-LNv recording; cells are nested observations and recording day is a blocking factor
sample_size_basis: pilot-derived effect size with biological-unit mixed model
primary_readout: peak and steady-state Shaw-sensitive K current density
controls: vehicle; driver_only; effector_only; background; time_matched; positive_current_control
analysis_plan: mixed-effects model with fly and day strata; prespecified contrasts and multiple-comparison control
expected_result_matrix: phase-dependent current loss with concordant membrane shift vs current-only effect vs null
alternative_explanations: off-target blocker; developmental compensation; cell-selection bias
go_no_go_rule: replicate in independent reagent or rescue and require concordant current and membrane outcomes
